entries.name: General Certificate of Education
entries.definition: UK-style academic qualifications, such as A Levels, awarded by several exam boards.

entries.name: General Certificate of Secondary Education
entries.definition: Subject qualifications taken in England, Wales and Northern Ireland at about age 16 and awarded by several exam boards.

entries.name: Gerontological Nurse Practitioner
entries.definition: A nurse practitioner credential for providing primary care to older adults.

entries.name: GIAC certification
entries.definition: The information-security certifications, such as GSEC and GCIH, awarded by Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC).

entries.name: GIAC Certified Enterprise Defender
entries.definition: A GIAC certification for practitioners who defend enterprise networks and systems with defensive techniques and tools.

entries.name: GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence
entries.definition: A GIAC certification for analysts who collect, analyse and apply cyber threat intelligence.

entries.name: GIAC Exploit Researcher and Advanced Penetration Tester
entries.definition: A GIAC certification for advanced penetration testers who find and exploit vulnerabilities in systems, networks and software.

entries.name: GIAC Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional
entries.definition: A GIAC certification on securing industrial control systems, bridging IT, engineering and cybersecurity.

entries.name: GIAC Information Security Fundamentals
entries.definition: An entry-level GIAC certification covering core information security concepts.

entries.name: GIAC Network Forensic Analyst
entries.definition: A GIAC certification for investigators who analyse network traffic and evidence in forensic investigations.

entries.name: GIAC Penetration Tester
entries.definition: A GIAC certification for penetration testers who run structured security tests of systems and networks.

entries.name: GIAC Security Essentials
entries.definition: A GIAC certification covering the essential information security skills and terms expected of hands-on security practitioners.

entries.name: GIAC Web Application Defender
entries.definition: A GIAC certification for people who defend web applications and understand web application security.

entries.name: GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester
entries.definition: A GIAC certification for testers who assess the security of web applications.

entries.name: GIS certificate
entries.definition: A certificate awarded for completing a course of study in geographic information systems.

entries.name: Google Ads Certification
entries.definition: Google's certifications, taken through its Skillshop learning platform, showing skill with Google Ads, formerly AdWords.

entries.name: Google Advanced Data Analytics Professional Certificate
entries.definition: Google's online professional certificate covering statistics, regression and machine learning for data analysis.

entries.name: Google Analytics Certification
entries.definition: Google's certification, taken through its Skillshop learning platform, showing skill with Google Analytics.

entries.name: Google Business Intelligence Professional Certificate
entries.definition: Google's online professional certificate covering how to build data models, pipelines, dashboards and reports for business decisions.

entries.name: Google Cloud Certified Associate Cloud Engineer
entries.definition: A Google Cloud certification showing that a person can deploy applications, monitor operations and manage solutions on Google Cloud.

entries.name: Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect
entries.definition: A Google Cloud certification showing that a person can design and manage secure, scalable cloud solutions on Google Cloud.

entries.name: Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate
entries.definition: Google's online professional certificate covering security fundamentals, networks, Linux, SQL and incident response for entry-level security roles.

entries.name: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate
entries.definition: Google's online professional certificate covering data cleaning, analysis, spreadsheets, SQL, R and visualisation for entry-level data analyst roles.

entries.name: Google Digital Marketing Certificate
entries.definition: A Google-issued online certificate covering digital marketing skills such as search, social media and e-commerce.

entries.name: Google IT Automation with Python Professional Certificate
entries.definition: Google's online professional certificate covering Python scripting, Git and automating IT tasks.

entries.name: Google IT Support Professional Certificate
entries.definition: Google's online professional certificate covering troubleshooting, networking, operating systems, system administration and security for entry-level IT support roles.

entries.name: Google Project Management Professional Certificate
entries.definition: Google's online professional certificate covering project planning, execution and agile practice.

entries.name: Google UX Design Professional Certificate
entries.definition: Google's online professional certificate covering user research, wireframes, prototypes and usability testing.

entries.name: Graduate REALTOR Institute
entries.definition: A real-estate designation of the National Association of Realtors, awarded by state Realtor associations to agents who complete a set of advanced courses.

entries.name: Hazmat endorsement
entries.definition: A commercial driver's licence endorsement that permits transporting hazardous materials, issued after a security background check.

entries.name: Higher National Certificate
entries.definition: A UK vocational qualification of about one year of full-time higher-education study, awarded by bodies such as Pearson and the Scottish Qualifications Authority.

entries.name: Housing Credit Certified Professional
entries.definition: A certification for professionals who manage compliance with the rules of the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit programme.

entries.name: IAM Level I certification
entries.definition: An information assurance management qualification at Level I, as defined in the U.S. Department of Defense 8570 workforce framework.

entries.name: IAM Level II certification
entries.definition: A Level II requirement in the US Department of Defense 8570 framework for information assurance management staff, met by holding an approved certification.

entries.name: IAM Level III certification
entries.definition: A Level III requirement in the US Department of Defense 8570 framework for information assurance management staff, met by holding an approved certification.

entries.name: IAT Level I certification
entries.definition: A Level I requirement in the US Department of Defense 8570 framework for information assurance technical staff, met by holding an approved certification.

entries.name: IAT Level II certification
entries.definition: A Level II requirement in the US Department of Defense 8570 framework for information assurance technical staff, met by holding an approved certification.

entries.name: IAT Level III certification
entries.definition: A Level III requirement in the US Department of Defense 8570 framework for information assurance technical staff, met by holding an approved certification.

entries.name: IBHRE certification
entries.definition: Certifications in heart rhythm management, such as the Certified Cardiac Device Specialist and Certified Electrophysiology Specialist, awarded by the International Board of Heart Rhythm Examiners.
variants: International Board of Heart Rhythm Examiners (IBHRE) Certification
International Board of Heart Rhythm Examiners certification

entries.name: IIBA Agile Analysis Certification
entries.definition: A certification from the International Institute of Business Analysis for business analysts who work in agile settings.
